mostWorthwhile.text: Binding the collected work into an encyclopedia gave the chapter a satisfying conclusion.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting each study separately became repetitive, even though the purpose was clear.

surprise.text: Thread and planks produced a loom when I expected binding equipment.

arbitrary.text: The loom felt disconnected from the encyclopedia goal; its purpose in this chapter remained unclear.

continue.text: I would not choose to continue immediately: bringing the studies together was satisfying, but the repeated fittings offered few meaningful choices.
